verdict.rationale: Highnote documents collaborative authorization (real-time approve/decline of authorizations, i.e. JIT-style funding control) and an integrated ledger for tracking balances, plus prefunded-style financial accounts and Plaid-connected external bank accounts, implying both prefunded and JIT funding models exist. However, there is no explicit documentation contrasting 'prefunded balance' vs 'just-in-time funding' as named funding models, nor any discussion of the cash-flow tradeoffs between them. Missing for 10: explicit naming/documentation of prefunded vs JIT funding modes as a configurable choice, and any cash-flow tradeoff analysis or guidance comparing the two.
